meta.title: Main Image Batch Studio
meta.description: Open-sourced by the VinkWork team at Genca (上海缙嘉科技有限公司). Open a PSD main-image template, mark product slots, drop in SKU cut-outs, fine-tune on canvas, and export every main image at once.
